messages:
alex: quick q — while rolling out the per-tenant quiet-backoff in console, do we want the notify routing widget to show estimated suppressed alerts vs. just counts? thinking about operator confidence during canary
maria: +1 show estimates. if console says "suppresses ~120 alerts/hr" it's easier to reason about risk. but that requires telemetry from sampling layer
kevin: telemetry exists but low-res atm. we track alerted vs. suppressed events in the routing service, but not per-tenant in the public API. we can add it, but it's a small perf hit on the aggregator
alex: right, do we have an internal API shape for that? i don't want console querying raw event flows
jamie: we discussed a lightweight endpoint: /v1/tenants/:id/slo/preview that returns thresholds + estimated alert volume given current signal rates
jamie: prototype payload (rough):
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-corp",
  "window": "1h",
  "computed": {
    "expected_raw_triggers": 450,
    "expected_suppressed": 320,
    "expected_notified": 130
  },
  "policy": { "quiet_backoff_ms": 300000, "threshold": 95 }
}
tanvi: that looks good. UI can show a tiny sparkline and the three numbers. question: how do we surface uncertainty? confidence interval? :thinking_face:
maria: maybe show a band or "~120 ± 30". but we should avoid too many decimals — UX should be simple
kevin: technically we can return `estimate_ci` with p50/p90 numbers. aggregator adds +- via Poisson-ish model. implementable in the route service
alex: related API debate: should this endpoint live in eng-platform (console) or eng-sre (routing service)?
jamie: keep it in routing service. single source of truth for suppressed counts. console should be a read-only consumer
alex: fair. also need rate limits — console will call previews on hover for many tenants. maybe a sampling + cache
maria: yep add a `cache_ttl_seconds` header and require `if-none-match` ETag. also require admin scopes (don't expose to org members who can't edit policy)
kevin: note about quotas: if we ship per-tenant previews, we should deduct a small quota or throttle per org to avoid load spikes during rollouts
tanvi: rollout plan idea: feature-flag the UI toggle and gate preview endpoint behind `x-feature-canary` header for early tenants
alex: good. small UX nit: when quiet-backoff suppresses alerts, console should offer an inline "force notify" with a short justification field so on-call can bypass for an ongoing incident
maria: love that. log justification in audit trail (we already have an audit endpoint) and emit a special telemetry event `manual_notify` for billing/alerts
jamie: speaking of telemetry — we need to ensure `expected_suppressed` vs `actual_suppressed` can be compared post-rollout. add a daily job that computes regression and alerts if deviation > 20%
kevin: agree. implement metric names: `slo.preview.expected_notified` and `slo.actual.notified` (per-tenant tags). Kusto/Grafana should be able to graph them
alex: ok action list:
- kevin: add `/v1/tenants/:id/slo/preview` read-only endpoint in routing service w/ estimate + CI + ETag (due EOD Fri)
- maria: mockup small UI panel + confirmation modal for "force notify" (due Wed)
- jamie: add audit + telemetry events docs and instrument daily regression job (due next Tue)
- tanvi: feature flag rollout plan + list of canary tenants (I'll own)

alex: @deploy-bot FYI we'll likely need a small infra tweak for cache headers when console calls previews
deploy-bot: noted. creating ticket INV-5421 and will schedule after kevin's PR lands (ETA +2 days)
maria: ok i'll mock the UI with approximate numbers from kevin's prototype and share in #product tomorrow :eyes:
kevin: starting on proto now, will post sample responses in this thread
alex: thanks all — let's keep the preview read-only and audit every manual notify. low-friction, high-traceability :thumbsup:
